patch_description:
This version retains the reliable unit-square hull construction from the current implementation, ensuring normalized hull area remains exactly one. It improves efficiency by updating only the 66 triangle areas affected when a single interior point moves, rather than recomputing all 286 triangle areas on every proposal.

The search combines deterministic multi-start simulated annealing, a lowest-area blend objective during exploration, and a final deterministic pattern-search refinement. Stratified initial layouts improve point coverage relative to purely uniform starts while seeded perturbations preserve reproducibility. All returned configurations contain exactly thirteen finite, distinct points inside or on the unit-square convex boundary.
